summary: One church, St. Joseph, Newton. The regular Mass and Saturday Confession schedule is identical in both bulletins and on the website. Adoration follows each weekend Mass (Sunday times from the website) and first Fridays; holy-day and Christmas Masses come from the parish website. Open: Adoration after the Saturday vigil, and the first-Friday Adoration start time.
